item.description: Most people have never heard of NexusTK. Some people maybe heard of it long ago. It’s different for me. Nexus: Kingdom of the Wind was my only MMO before EverQuest rewrote the MMO rulebook.

item.title: Salt & Sanctuary: When Watching Elden Ring Isn't Enough
item.description: My partner is playing our copy of Elden Ring, and I’d love to do more than just watch. Doesn’t make much sense to buy another…
